resolution.title: [chassis] Fix test_bgp_update_timer for T2 topologies
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Arvindsrinivasan Lakshminarasimhan <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #5176

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
Update the `test_bgp_update_timer` to run on T2 topologies

#### How did you do it?
The following changes are done.
- Change the test and conftest to use `enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname`, to avoid the test from running on supervisor
- Change the subnet used to setup bgp session from `<IP>/24` to `<IP>/24`
- use `minigraph_ptf_indices` to get the correct PTF interfaces in the t2 topology.
